arms.blk: block-interleaved, zero footprint overlap, one-block void band; all test patches inside the train extent
arms.hon: isolated protocol zones, subsampled to identical counts, prevalence-matched; buffer-isolated

config.note: Both arms have identical counts, identical recipe and zero overlap. Counts are 19-25 train / 3-6 test against the protocol's 40/10/10; that reduction is forced by the geometry (see experiments/make_block_split.py) and is why the split seed, not the run seed, is the resampling unit.

between_arm_sign_test.note: exact two-sided sign test over split seeds; with n=19 the smallest attainable p is 0.000
